title: A Request for a Meeting
text:
Dear Ms. Brown, I am writing to request a meeting about the new project. The meeting could be on Tuesday or Thursday afternoon. I hope this time is convenient for you.

Please let me know which day is best for you. You can reply to this email or call me at the office. Thank you for your help. Kind regards, David Green.

questions.text: On which days could the meeting be?

options: By replying to the email or calling

questions.text: What is the main purpose of the email?
How does David Green probably feel about the meeting?

vocabulary.definition: an event where people come together to discuss something
suitable and easy for someone to do
to answer a letter, email, or message

paragraph_translations: Prezada Sra. Brown, escrevo para solicitar uma reunião sobre o novo projeto. A reunião poderia ser na terça ou na quinta à tarde. Espero que este horário seja conveniente para a senhora.
Por favor, avise-me qual dia é melhor para a senhora. Pode responder a este e-mail ou me ligar no escritório. Obrigado pela sua ajuda. Atenciosamente, David Green.
